EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KARACHCHI PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of a return member of Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party, the recognized political party to whichKumarasamy Tharumarasa the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance,to decide upon returned member if Sri Lanka Freedom Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualified underSection 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a periodof thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Visvanathan Vithiyananthan to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Denicius Canute Aravintharaj, Returning Officer of the Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Selection 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatVisvanathan Vithiyananathan was selected as the member of the Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha.
D. C. ARAVINTHARAJ,Returning Officer,Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Kilinochchi,11th April, 2019.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
